metadata.model: Black-Scholes-Merton; European exercise; continuous constant dividend yield q
metadata.numeric_representation: decimal scientific notation in JSON strings; 1+19 mantissa digits
metadata.input_policy: Round nominal inputs to 20 significant decimal digits, then reparse those published strings at working precision before all BSM calculations.
metadata.fractional_time_policy: T_years is the authoritative 20-digit decimal approximation; the rational label identifies its nominal grid origin.
metadata.theta_day_scaling: annual call theta / 252 or / 365; a derivative scaling, not a finite one-day repricing
metadata.vega_scaling: dV/dsigma * 0.01; same for call and put
metadata.rho_scaling: dV/dr_cont * 0.01; q fixed; continuous-rate percentage point
metadata.r_and_q_convention: annual continuously compounded rate and continuous dividend yield, in decimal units
metadata.price_units: per one unit of underlying; S and K in the same currency; no contract multiplier
metadata.parity_residual_scope: computed on independent unrounded call and put at 50 dps; only the residual is then printed to 20 significant digits
metadata.parity_residual_serialized_scope: recomputed at 50 dps from the exported 20-digit call/put prices and input strings; not subject to the internal 1e-30 criterion
metadata.limit_policy: Strictly positive sigma=1e-6 or T=1e-9, separately; no zero-volatility or expiry substitution, clipping, or parity-derived put.
